purpose.is: Moves a change to the owner's page or the command center map through dev, uat and stable without a hand step and without stopping the stable watcher: a pr.opened brings the dev tier up on the head sha and screenshots it; a green gate on that sha brings uat up and screenshots it for the reviewer (and for the owner's confirm when the change touches the owner-locked assets, #owner-confirm); a merge restarts stable on the merge sha's workspace and screenshots it for the owner's card.
Every promotion record carries the screenshot record (1280 and 430 wide, both read by the look check), so the picture comes before the card (owner, 2026-10-14: why do you never screenshot?).
purpose.is-not: It does not judge the picture's beauty; the reviewer (N-19) and the owner do. It checks the look tokens mechanically and it proves the page answers.
purpose.why: HANDOFF checkpoint 03:51Z: make upgrade was not run because it stops stable and its waits; the server was replaced by hand with SIGKILL and server.mjs --join, which is a hand line operation and a defect for the spec book: upgrade must swap stable without stopping the waits. The owner's always-on monitor never stops on a halt (bearings-stable-is-the-only-always-on-monitor).

input.record: A PR whose changed paths match promotion.paths (tools/bearings/** or the map app path the G6 volumes name) with its head sha; tier dev.
Green on that head sha; tier uat. (Drawn as part of the pr.opened traversal: the node holds the promotion in state dev until the gate record arrives.)
A merge whose changed paths match promotion.paths; tier stable.

output.record: Tier, sha, the URL, the server pid and port, the swap method, the screenshot record id, the look check rows, the health probe result; for stable, previous_sha (the workspace the pointer was renamed from, kept for rollback).
The new server did not answer healthy within its timeout or the look check failed hard (a token missing); stable is untouched (the old server keeps serving); dev or uat is torn down.
Three attempts failed; owner acts for stable (one card with the last screenshot or the error), system acts for dev and uat (the ticket's next attempt).
Attached to the promotion: paths of the two PNGs under the state root, the tier URL, the viewport sizes, the computed look tokens.
output.reads: N-28 (the stable promotion is one owner card with the screenshot: the page changed, here is what it looks like; dev and uat are not cards), N-32 (the page shows its own version and sha in the strip), N-19 (the uat screenshot is in the reviewer brief).

tier.name: dev
tier.runs-from: a workspace at the head sha, ${COQ_STATE}/tiers/<project>-dev-<ticket>/src@<sha>, with current pointing at it
tier.port: first free in the dev range
tier.who: the worker's own check and the test suite
tier.lifetime: until merge or ticket dead; N-45 removes it on the merge trigger

tier.name: uat
tier.runs-from: a workspace at the gate-green head sha, ${COQ_STATE}/tiers/<project>-uat-<ticket>/src@<sha>
tier.port: first free in the uat range
tier.who: the reviewer seat through its brief; the owner on the confirm card when the change touches the owner-locked assets (#owner-confirm)

tier.name: stable
tier.runs-from: a workspace at the merge sha, ${COQ_STATE}/tiers/<project>-stable/src@<sha>, with current pointing at it and the previous kept for rollback
tier.port: fixed (config tiers.stable.port, 44900) on loopback; the tailnet door forwards to it (N-34)
tier.who: the owner, every day; the phone on the tailnet
tier.lifetime: always; never stopped except for the restart of a promotion

tiers.s: Every value comes from tools/bearings/config/bearings.json as today (tiers, ports, page names); a tier is the systemd user unit coq-bearings@<page> (nodes/N-32/spec.xml#start), never a pane and never under an agent (D08); its state lives under ${COQ_STATE}/bearings/<page>/ and its records in the store, never in JSONL files (nodes/N-32/spec.xml#purpose).

The map app (G6) promotes on the same record with its own hello page as the first proof; on every bearings tier the map is the bundle served at /board from the tier's workspace, so the tier promotion promotes it too; its public static build lives on the cluster behind map.gatehouse.click through Argo (N-35), so for the public name the stable step is the gitops tag bump N-35 already makes and the screenshot is taken against the public name.

owner-confirm.s: This section is the one answer to who gates a page change (gap review R-03, 2026-10-14); nodes/N-09/spec.xml#m-hold, N-28#input, N-29#mechanism step 4, N-32#cut-over step 2 and shared/command-center.xml#requirements point here.
owner-confirm.rule: The owner-locked assets are tools/bearings/assets/page.html and tools/bearings/assets/theme.css (config promotion.confirm_paths): "the page markup and theme are the owner's and are not changed without an approved sample" (tools/bearings/AGENTS.md, the owner's SKILL rule). A pull request whose paths touch them waits for the owner's confirm before it merges: at gate green this node brings uat up, screenshots it at both widths, and N-28 posts one promotion.confirm 300 card on the uat tier with the screenshot pair and the look rows; the owner's pick is a ruling (N-29 effect promotion.confirm naming the head sha); N-09 holds the merge with merge.held reason awaiting-owner-confirm until that ruling exists for the current head. The owner's approval is the sample.

Every other change under promotion.paths (the Go page service, the map bundle, the config) merges on the machine verdict (D15: green gate plus review.passed) and reaches stable on the merge record with no approval asked; the owner sees one card after the fact with the screenshot, and can revert through the Controls screen (no-bureaucracy-creep).

Bounded, never a cog: the confirm card carries a default (not confirmed: the pull request stays held) and a deadline, ages once to alert.aged at its escalation bound (shared/status-codes.xml#escalation-bound), and holds only its own pull request; every other merge proceeds. A new head re-arms the card, because the owner confirmed a picture of one sha.

mechanism.where: Go package promote in the service decides; tools/bearings/scripts/promote.sh does the tier work as an Executor.Run verb; tools/bearings/scripts/screenshot.sh takes the pictures in a pinned playwright container on the host (podman, --network=host, so loopback and the tailnet address are reachable; the cluster cannot reach the host, D23).
mechanism.step: On pr.opened: take lease tier:dev-<ticket>; provision the workspace at the head sha (git worktree from the mirror) and build the page binary into it (make -C tools/bearings build in the pinned coq-go image under podman); point current at it (write a temporary symlink, rename it over current); start or restart unit coq-bearings@<project>-dev-<ticket>, whose ExecStart runs the binary and assets of current; probe GET /health until 200 or timeout; screenshot; look check; promotion 201 dev.

On gate.verdict green for the same sha: the same on the uat range; the reviewer brief (N-19) gets the uat URL and the screenshot paths; when the paths touch the owner-locked assets, N-28 posts the confirm card (#owner-confirm).

On merge: take lease tier:stable; provision src@<merge sha> and build its binary; rename current to point at it, keeping the previous target as previous; systemctl --user restart coq-bearings@<project>-stable, which drains for up to 5 s and starts on the same port 44900 from the new workspace (nodes/N-32/spec.xml#tiers); probe /health 200 and GET / with the page key 200 within promotion.probe_timeout; screenshot the stable URL; promotion 201 stable with previous_sha.

The watcher (coq-watcher@<page>, N-27) is its own unit holding a store lease and tailing the store; it reads no page file and no page process, so the restart is invisible to it; the owner's answers and messages are store records and the browser queues an act made during the 2 s gap and resends it by id (nodes/N-32/spec.xml#mechanism step 5); browsers show DISCONNECTED and resume by Last-Event-ID with no seq lost. The front door (coq-front-door@<page>, N-34) is bound to the page unit and restarts with it, reading the port once at its start; the phone's EventSource reconnects through it. Nothing in this step calls make stop or make upgrade, and nothing repoints a port.

screenshot.sh opens the tier URL with the viewer key, waits for the page's ready marker (a data-ready attribute the page sets after its first state render), takes 1280x800 and 430x932 (iPhone 16 Pro Max CSS px) PNGs, and reads getComputedStyle of the look tokens (the CSS custom properties of shared/principles.xml#krastorio-look) into JSON.

The look check compares each token with the value in shared/principles.xml#krastorio-look (values only, original art); a missing token is a hard fail (422); a differing value is a row with code 422 on that row and the promotion proceeds for dev and uat (the reviewer sees the row) but not for stable (a stable restart with a failing look row is rolled back and refused 422 so the owner never sees a wrong page; the merge is already on main, so the fix is a fix ticket request from N-11).
mechanism.rollback: If the restarted unit fails its probe or the look check, rename current back to previous and restart again (the old sha serves within one more 2 s gap); promotion 422 and the next attempt (N-11) retries the same sha up to three times, then 423 and one card.

diagram.mermaid: sequenceDiagram participant M as merge record participant S as Go promote participant W as workspace src@sha (current) participant U as unit coq-bearings@project-stable participant F as front door (N-34, bound to U) participant P as screenshot.sh M->>S: merge sha touching promotion.paths S->>W: provision, build binary, rename current (previous kept) S->>U: systemctl --user restart (drain 5 s, same port) U-->>F: front door restarts with the unit S->>U: GET /health, GET / (key) until 200 (timeout 60 s) alt probe or look fails S->>W: rename current back to previous S->>U: restart again; promotion 422 else healthy S->>P: 1280 and 430 PNG + look tokens P-->>S: screenshot record S-->>M: promotion 201 stable (previous_sha) end

start.s: pr.opened, gate.verdict and merge are records the service already consumes; the promotion is a handler on them; no builder runs make serve, no architect runs make upgrade, no one runs SIGKILL.

The owner sees a stable promotion as one card with the picture, after the fact, with no approval asked (no-bureaucracy-creep), except for a change to the owner-locked assets, which the owner confirms on the uat card before it merges (#owner-confirm); the owner can hold the line or revert through a card or the Controls screen, which is a new traversal.

wait.fallback: re-queue on the next tick; a stale lease is reclaimed by N-02 after its expiry (PT15M)
one attempt of three; 422 with reason provision

wait.what: the restarted unit's /health and / with key
wait.fallback: rename current back to previous and restart; 422; retry per N-11

wait.timeout: PT5S (the unit's own stop bound, nodes/N-32/spec.xml#mechanism step 9)
wait.fallback: systemd's SIGKILL after TimeoutStopSec; browsers reconnect to the new instance

wait.what: the owner's confirm for a change to the owner-locked assets (#owner-confirm)
wait.timeout: none for the line; the card's escalation bound for the card
wait.fallback: the pull request stays merge.held awaiting-owner-confirm; the card ages once to alert.aged; every other merge proceeds
one retry inside the attempt; then the promotion is 201 with screenshot missing marked (for dev and uat) or 422 (for stable, because the owner's card must carry the picture)
take the picture anyway and mark not-ready in the screenshot record; the look check still runs
N-35's contract: Argo status polled by the tick; after the timeout promotion 422 for the map tier and N-35's runbook applies

waits.cog-test: The cog that could stall this node is the architect running make upgrade by hand and then telling the owner. The handler on the merge record, the restart on the renamed workspace pointer and the automatic screenshot remove the hand and the telling.

retries.policy: Per promotion of one sha on one tier; the attempt counter is on the promotion key tier:sha.
retries.recover: Stable is never left broken: a failed attempt renames the pointer back and the previous sha serves again; after three, promotion 423, one card with the error and the last screenshot if any; the lamp on the Controls screen shows stable behind main with the sha gap.
retries.report: Dev and uat failures are rows in the worker's or reviewer's next brief; a stable 423 is one card; a look-row mismatch on stable is a fix ticket request, once per token.

many-agents.readers: Many PRs touch the page at once: each has its own dev and uat tier (port from the range, page name with the ticket), so twenty builders never share a page; the range size is config and a full range is a 429 row that re-queues.
many-agents.writers: Stable has one lease (tier:stable); two merges touching the page within a minute serialize; the second restart waits for the first to finish and then restarts again; the owner sees two cards or, if N-28's dedupe window folds them, one card naming both shas.
many-agents.collision: A promotion of sha A running when sha B merges: B waits on the lease; after A's 201, B provisions and restarts; stable ends on B; the records show the order; no page state is lost because the state is in the store, not in the workspace.

An owner answer arriving during the restart: the browser queues it and resends by its id after the 2 s gap, and the watcher (N-27) delivers whatever the store already holds; Intake is idempotent on the record id, so an answer seen twice rules once (nodes/N-29/spec.xml#many-agents).
A screenshot container and the owner on the phone at the same moment: the page serves both; the screenshot uses its own key-bearing URL and never writes.
A builder seat starting the same dev tier by hand: refused, because the tier units are system-owned and the seat deny list covers make serve, make wait, make stop and make upgrade (seat-contract).

status-codes.emits: Promoted; system acts (dev, uat); owner reads one card (stable).
Attempt failed (probe, look hard fail, provision); system acts (retry).
Failed after 3; owner acts for stable (one card); seat acts for dev and uat (next attempt gets the rows).
No free port in the tier range; system acts (re-queue next tick).
Pictures and tokens recorded; nobody acts.

path.holds: lease tier:<name>; stable keeps the current and the previous sha (rollback), older ones go on the timer
never the stable tier's state directory

state-paths.path: Dev and uat tier state directories (nodes/N-32/spec.xml#state-paths).
The pictures; the record names them; stable's are kept 365 days (a second entry N-48.screenshots-stable).
Stable pictures, the owner's history of the page.

path.glob: systemd user instances coq-bearings@<project>-dev-*.service and coq-bearings@<project>-uat-*.service (instances of the one template)
path.cleanup: line/bin/cleanup.sh --entry N-48.units (systemctl --user stop the instance and reset-failed it)

state-paths.path: Dev and uat unit instances; the template is installed by N-32's install-units.sh and lives in the repository under tools/bearings/units/.

edges.in: gate.verdict green (uat step of the same traversal)
edges.out: promotion (the strip shows the live sha and version)

item.check: A stable promotion never stops the watcher and loses nothing the owner typed.
item.proof: A test world with coq-watcher and the front door running; a merge record; the watcher pid is unchanged after promotion 201, the front door is active again within 10 s, an answer posted during the restart rules exactly once, and the browser's seq set has no gap.

item.check: A failed probe rolls back to the previous sha.
item.proof: A new workspace whose binary returns 500 on /health; promotion 422; current points at the previous sha again; GET / on the stable port 200.

item.check: A change to the owner-locked assets waits for the owner's confirm; any other change does not.
item.proof: Two test PRs, one touching theme.css and one touching cmd/coq-bearings: the first is merge.held awaiting-owner-confirm until a promotion.confirm ruling for its head; the second merges on gate green plus review.passed.

item.check: Both screenshots exist and the look tokens are read.
item.proof: Two PNGs under the state root with the right sizes, and a screenshot record whose tokens object has every name in the look volume.

item.check: A missing look token refuses stable.
item.proof: A page with one token removed; promotion 422 reason look; current renamed back and the previous sha serving.

item.check: Dev and uat tiers are per ticket and torn down on merge.
item.proof: Two PRs open at once produce two dev pages on different ports; after one merges, N-45's merge trigger removes that ticket's dev and uat directories and units.

item.check: No hand step exists in the path.
item.proof: The N-51 line-ops audit for the day of a stable promotion shows zero hand operations and the promotion record lists the unit names.

item.check: The map tier promotes through gitops.
item.proof: N-35's deploy record referenced from a promotion 201 for the map, screenshot of map.gatehouse.click at both sizes.

may.do: provision tier workspaces, rename the current pointer, start, stop and restart tier units, run the screenshot container, write promotion and screenshot records
hold or revert stable through a card or the Controls screen (a control.action that promotes the previous sha)
read the uat URL and the screenshots in its brief; never start a tier

may-not.do: make serve, make wait, make stop, make upgrade, start any tier unit, touch a tier workspace or its pointer, kill a server

stop the watcher units; delete the stable tier's state directory; swap stable on a sha without a merge record and a green main (N-10 hold applies: a merge.hold stops stable promotions until main is green)

monitoring.counter: Commits on main touching promotion.paths since the sha stable runs; over 0 for an hour is an alert record.
Time from merge record to promotion 201.
monitoring.lamp: Green when the gap is 0 and the last probe was 200; amber with a gap; red on a 423 or when the front door or the watcher is dead (N-27).

runbook.step: Read the latest promotion record for stable; a 422 shows the probe or look reason; the retry runs on its own; after a 423 the card says what failed.

step.when: the owner wants the previous page back

runbook.step: Controls screen: revert stable to previous sha (a control.action); the handler renames current to src@previous and restarts with the same mechanism; a card records it.
tools/bearings/scripts/promote.sh --tier stable --sha <sha> by the owner, which writes the same records and is counted by N-51 as a hand line operation for that day.
The PNG paths are in the screenshot record; the owner reads them on the card; a wrong look is a fix ticket, never a hand edit of page.html on main (L08 finding 10).
runbook.cleanup: line/bin/cleanup.sh --entry N-48.tier-src, N-48.pages, N-48.screenshots, N-48.screenshots-stable, N-48.log, N-48.units.
runbook.cold-start: The stable unit is enabled and starts with the user session from the workspace current points at; the front door and the watcher are their own units (N-34, N-27); the tick compares stable's sha with main and promotes if behind.

reject.source: tools/bearings Makefile upgrade (stop stable, pull main, serve)
reject.reason: Stops the owner's always-on monitor and its waits; replaced by the restart on a renamed workspace pointer with the watcher as its own unit.
A hand line operation; the exit test counts it; the handler does the same swap as code.

reject.source: herdr panes for tier servers and waits (tools/bearings/AGENTS.md Run it)
reject.reason: D08: herdr is the owner's window; every system process is its own unit.

reject.source: SO_REUSEPORT on the stable port, and the round 1 blue-green backend on a fresh loopback port behind a server.json repoint
reject.reason: Desktop browsers reach 127.0.0.1:44900 directly, so a fresh backend port needs a second loopback proxy, and the tailnet door would need a per-connection re-read; both add moving parts to avoid a 2 s DISCONNECTED that loses nothing (answers are records, the browser queues, SSE resumes by Last-Event-ID).
D23 pods egress only to GitHub and GHCR and cannot reach the host's loopback or tailnet; the container runs on the host under podman.

reject.source: an owner approval card before every stable promotion
reject.reason: D15 and no-bureaucracy-creep: the machine verdict merged it; the owner sees the picture and can revert; a gate that waits on the owner is a cog. The one exception is the owner's own rule on the owner-locked assets, decided once in #owner-confirm.
Another project's node_modules is not a pinned dependency; the screenshot image is digest-pinned in images.json.

shared-needs.need: principles.xml#owner-surface (bearings never stops, one surface) and principles.xml#krastorio-look with the token table: CSS custom property names and values from the art inventory section 4 (values only).
The seat deny list covers make serve, wait, stop, upgrade, front-door and any systemctl --user call; a seat never starts a tier.
promotions: tier, sha, attempt, state, pid, port, screenshot_id, previous_sha; leases tier:<name>.
promotion, screenshot, pr.opened (changed paths), gate.verdict, merge (changed paths), control.action (revert stable).

promotion.paths (tools/bearings/**, the map app path from G6), promotion.confirm_paths (tools/bearings/assets/page.html, tools/bearings/assets/theme.css), tiers.*.port_range, tiers.stable.port, promotion.probe_timeout PT60S, promotion.drain PT30S, screenshot image digest in images.json, viewport sizes 1280x800 and 430x932.
The front door is bound to the page unit (BindsTo) and restarts with it, reading the port once at start (nodes/N-34/spec.xml#start).
The watcher is its own unit holding a store lease and tailing the store, never bound to the page process (nodes/N-27/spec.xml#mechanism); it survives a page restart.

The unit's ExecStart runs the binary and assets of the tier's current workspace; page.html sets a data-ready marker after the first render and exposes the look tokens as CSS custom properties; the strip shows the live sha.
merge.held reason awaiting-owner-confirm for a pull request touching promotion.confirm_paths with no promotion.confirm ruling on its head (#owner-confirm).
The map's stable promotion is a gitops tag bump with Argo sync status readable by the tick.
